title: anthoxanthum nitens subsp. kolymense
intro: Anthoxanthum nitens subsp. kolymense, commonly known as Kolyma oat grass, is a plant species belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Kolyma oat grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been studied for their potential to exhibit immunomodulatory and anti-cancer properties.
